first.rationale: Onboarding completion is down and prior evidence links a shorter onboarding flow to faster time-to-value and early adoption, making it the strongest direct route to sustainable qualified revenue. Verify the onboarding result and the competing pricing evidence because aggressive pricing may address the immediate SMB threat but could trade off long-term value or margin.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding. The verified prior result directly addresses the current 4% completion decline and showed completion +13%, 2.1 fewer days to value, and 30-day retention +3%, supporting sustainable qualified revenue rather than only top-of-funnel volume. Promotional pricing is not selected despite the competitor threat: its verified uplift came with 30-day retention down 12% and failed to sustain through renewal. Guard the test with qualified-revenue and early-retention checks, since the current activation decline may have additional causes beyond onboarding friction.
